lessonTitle: 72. Ratio of linear elements of similar triangles
lessonTitleEnglish: Ratio of linear elements of similar triangles
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Corresponding heights, medians and bisectors of similar triangles are in the ratio k.
stages.headlineEnglish: Corresponding heights, medians and bisectors of similar triangles are in the ratio k.

stages.headline: The ratio of perimeters also equals k: P₁ : P = k.
stages.headlineEnglish: The ratio of perimeters also equals k: P₁ : P = k.

stages.headline: Example: perimeters 12 and 18 give k = 1.5; a height of 4 in the small one becomes 6.
